svg.title: Machyon: every image, Mach speed, zero lost. Async image downloader for Python.
svg.text: Every image. Mach speed. Zero lost.
Async image downloader for Python. It tunes its own speed, checks that every file
really is an image, and records why anything couldn't be downloaded.
